# dadaia-workspace

> A local-first, spec-driven workspace that gives AI agents current context, a document-governed lifecycle, visible concurrency and anti-slop boundaries.

## What it is

<!-- derived-from: product-vision sha256:16060412dc8a -->

- [README](README.md): one workspace folder, projects in repos inside it, governance outside every repo; the unit is the context (main repo + associated repos); documents are the lifecycle; boundaries are mechanical.

## Install

<!-- derived-from: pypi-distribution sha256:ab76c52ed560 -->
<!-- derived-from: workspace-init sha256:0c2017836e6f -->

- [PyPI project](https://pypi.org/project/dadaia-workspace/): three levels — `uvx dadaia-workspace init <dir> --harness <name> --repo <url>` (workspace + project: cloned, ALIVE, bound), then `.dadaia/.venv/bin/dadaia specs init --context <slug>` (specs on the canon) and `.dadaia/.venv/bin/dadaia doctor`; every later command runs through `.dadaia/.venv/bin/dadaia`; re-running the `uvx` init line upgrades the workspace.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): written by release-please, one section per released version.

## The law

<!-- derived-from: agentic-entities sha256:9f356fd0a4ec -->
<!-- derived-from: sdd-gate-v3 sha256:729431b8ca75 -->

- [AGENTS.md](dadaia_workspace/public/data/AGENTS.md): the always-on root map — flow, roles, gate invariants, where things live, the index of every scoped `AGENTS.md` and skill; projected once to the workspace root.

<!-- derived-from: pypi-distribution sha256:ab76c52ed560 -->

- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): the committed output of `.dadaia/.venv/bin/dadaia help tree`.

- [Memory catalog](specs/memory/product/index.md): every product atom, its `tldr` and its path.

## The docs

<!-- derived-from: pypi-distribution sha256:ab76c52ed560 -->
<!-- derived-from: product-vision sha256:16060412dc8a -->

- [Documentation](https://github.com/marcoaureliomenezes/dadaia-workspace/tree/main/docs): the repository's `docs/` folder on `main`, every page derived under its markers.
- [Landing](docs/index.md): the tagline, the paradigm and the two ways in.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): the three levels (workspace, project, specs) in one shell block, doctor, first backlog entry, first release, upgrade.
- [Positioning](docs/positioning.md): product repos never carry agent config; one law governs many projects.
- [The bug loop](docs/bug-loop.md): register, RED, fix, resolve with evidence and lineage.
- [What the bug ledger taught](docs/bug-ledger-lessons.md): how to measure the ledger, and the fix-chain lesson — an additive fix breeds the next bug, a deletion-shaped fix ends the family.
